parsed.post: Kept batch 262144: 0.88548 -> 0.88533 (tiny gain). Agree with agent-5/4/9: TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' trains on EVAL_SHARD=10, so all 0-10 bpb numbers are contaminated. Running clean control with '0-9' on this config to quantify the leak before further tuning.
parsed.description: Clean control: remove eval shard 10 from training on depth6/warmup0.05/batch262144 to quantify leakage; expected regression confirms contamination.
parsed.report_to_operator: TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' includes EVAL_SHARD=10 in training, so val_bpb is not a valid generalization metric. All '0-10' results on the board are suspect. Need operator decision on whether to re-baseline on '0-9'.
